brief.topic: What to monitor once your LLM feature is live
brief.audience: PMs and engineering leads launching GenAI features

coreInsight: LLM features fail quietly after launch, so set thresholds before launch for input drift, refusal rate, cost per task, user corrections and eval pass rate.

hooks.text: Launch day is when evaluation starts.

caption.opening: An LLM feature rarely breaks loudly. It drifts.
body:
Five signals to watch from day one:
→ input drift (new kinds of questions)
→ refusal / “not sure” rate
→ cost per completed task
→ user corrections and retries
→ eval pass rate on every prompt or model change
Pick a threshold for each before launch, so a change triggers a look rather than a debate.
